conclusion: The project now prohibits F.Cu tracks, vias and copper pours across the complete body outline. D+ uses R11 outside the body; CC1 is rerouted outside the body. Connector pads retain the manufacturer footprint dimensions.
drawing_0_10_note: The 0.10 callout has a geometric flatness symbol; it is not a guaranteed PCB standoff.
keepout_origin: Conservative project rule added in response to the user; not claimed as a manufacturer mandate.
residual_scope: Ordinary assembly inspection and USB signal-integrity testing still apply. R11 package delay is not part of the 2D uniform impedance calculation.
